metadata.title: Foundational AI Research Papers Timeline
metadata.description: A curated list of the most influential AI research papers that drove the technological revolution.

papers.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.description: The seminal AlexNet paper that brought deep learning back into prominence by winning the ILSVRC-2012 competition with a large convolutional neural network trained on GPUs.

papers.title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
papers.description: Introduced the Word2Vec algorithm, fundamentally changing NLP by demonstrating that word embeddings capture syntactic and semantic regularities.

papers.title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.description: The first paper to successfully apply deep learning to reinforcement learning, showing a single agent learning multiple Atari games directly from pixels.

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Nets
papers.description: Introduced the GAN framework, pitting a generative model against a discriminative model, revolutionizing the generation of highly realistic synthetic images.

papers.title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
papers.description: Introduced Dropout, a highly effective technique to prevent overfitting in deep neural networks by randomly omitting units during training.

papers.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
papers.description: Introduced the attention mechanism for neural machine translation, allowing the model to focus on relevant parts of the source sentence during translation.
key_contributions: Joint learning of alignment and translation

papers.title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
papers.description: Introduced VGGNet, proving that increasing the depth of convolutional networks using very small convolution filters (3x3) leads to significant improvements in recognition.

papers.title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
papers.description: Introduced the encoder-decoder architecture using multi-layered LSTMs, fundamental for all subsequent seq2seq applications.
key_contributions: Reversing source sentences to improve optimization

papers.title: Going Deeper with Convolutions
papers.description: Introduced Inception (GoogLeNet), a deep convolutional architecture that uses 'Inception' modules to perform multi-scale processing while remaining computationally efficient.

papers.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
papers.institution: University of Amsterdam / University of Toronto
papers.description: Introduced Adam, an algorithm for first-order gradient-based optimization of stochastic objective functions. It has become the default optimizer for training deep neural networks.
key_contributions: Invariant to diagonal rescaling of the gradients

papers.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
papers.description: Introduced Batch Normalization, allowing for much higher learning rates and less careful initialization by normalizing layer inputs.
key_contributions: Faster and more stable training of deep networks

papers.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
papers.description: Introduced the U-Net architecture, consisting of a contracting path to capture context and a symmetric expanding path that enables precise localization. It became the gold standard for medical image segmentation.
key_contributions: Data augmentation for small medical datasets

papers.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
papers.description: Introduced YOLO, the first real-time object detection system that treats detection as a single regression problem, directly from image pixels to bounding box coordinates and class probabilities.
key_contributions: Global reasoning on images avoiding false positives in backgrounds

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.description: Introduced ResNet, which solved the vanishing gradient problem in extremely deep networks using skip connections, becoming the default architecture for many vision tasks.

papers.title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
papers.description: The landmark paper demonstrating the first computer program capable of defeating a world champion Go player by combining deep neural networks with advanced tree search.
key_contributions: Hybrid AI system combining deep neural networks with Monte Carlo Tree Search
Introduction of policy and value networks for move selection and evaluation
Combination of supervised learning and reinforcement learning (self-play)
Proof of viability for combining deep learning with advanced search at scale

papers.title: Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer
papers.description: Introduced a Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts layer, paving the way for massive scale networks with sublinear compute requirements.
key_contributions: Massive capacity increase without proportional compute increase

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.description: The foundational paper for modern LLMs. It introduced the Transformer architecture, dispensing with recurrence entirely in favor of self-attention mechanisms.

papers.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
papers.description: Introduced PPO, an RL method that strikes a balance between ease of tuning, sample complexity, and performance. It became the default RL algorithm used in RLHF for large language models.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.description: Introduced a novel way to pre-train deep bidirectional representations, breaking records across numerous NLP tasks and forming the backbone of Google Search.

papers.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
papers.description: Introduced GPT-2, demonstrating that language models could perform surprisingly well in zero-shot settings across a variety of domains simply by scaling up parameters and data.

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.description: Provided empirical evidence that language model performance scales predictably with compute, dataset size, and parameter count, laying the foundation for modern LLM scaling strategies.
key_contributions: Compute vs. Data vs. Parameter tradeoffs

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.description: Introduced RAG, a hybrid architecture combining a pre-trained sequence-to-sequence model with a dense vector index of Wikipedia for enhanced factual accuracy.
key_contributions: Integration of parametric and non-parametric memory
End-to-end training of retriever and generator

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
papers.description: Introduced GPT-3 (175B parameters), showing that massive scaling leads to emergent few-shot learning capabilities without requiring gradient updates or fine-tuning.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.description: Popularized high-quality image synthesis using diffusion models, connecting diffusion probabalistic models to denoising score matching. This started the diffusion generative revolution.
key_contributions: High-fidelity image generation surpassing GANs in diversity

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.description: Demonstrated that a pure Transformer architecture applied directly to sequences of image patches can perform at or above the state-of-the-art on image classification when pre-trained on large datasets, pioneering the Vision Transformer (ViT) paradigm.
key_contributions: Proof that Transformers can replace CNNs for vision

papers.title: Zero-Shot Text-to-Image Generation
papers.description: Introduced DALL-E, a 12 billion parameter autoregressive transformer trained to generate images from text captions, demonstrating zero-shot image generation capabilities across a wide range of concepts.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.description: Introduced CLIP, an extremely effective method for contrastive text-image pretraining that enables zero-shot image classification and robust vision-language integration.
key_contributions: Zero-shot transfer to many image classification tasks
Bridging visual and textual modalities effectively

papers.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
papers.description: Introduced Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), encoding absolute positional information with a rotation matrix that naturally incorporates relative position dependency. Adopted by virtually all modern LLMs including LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen.
key_contributions: Unified absolute and relative position encoding
Adopted by majority of modern LLMs

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.description: Introduced LoRA, freezing the pretrained model weights and injecting trainable rank decomposition matrices into the architecture, greatly reducing the number of trainable parameters.
key_contributions: Massive reduction in VRAM required for fine-tuning
Same or better performance compared to full fine-tuning

papers.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
papers.description: Detailed AlphaFold 2, a revolutionary AI system fundamentally solving the 50-year-old grand challenge of predicting a protein's 3D structure from its amino acid sequence.
key_contributions: Evoformer architecture combining evolutionary and spatial information

papers.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
papers.description: Introduced Latent Diffusion Models (LDM), which perform the diffusion process in a compressed latent space rather than pixel space, enabling high-quality image synthesis like Stable Diffusion with far less compute.
key_contributions: Compression into latent space via VQ-GAN

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.description: Demonstrated that prompting LLMs to generate a series of intermediate reasoning steps significantly improves performance on complex reasoning tasks.
key_contributions: Emergent reasoning abilities in large-scale models

papers.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
papers.description: Introduced InstructGPT, applying Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to align language models with user intent. This paper forms the basis for ChatGPT.

papers.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
papers.description: Introduced the 'Chinchilla' scaling laws, proving that previous LLMs were significantly undertrained. It showed that model scale and training tokens must scale equally.
key_contributions: 70B model outperforming 280B model through more data

papers.title: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
papers.description: Introduced DALL-E 2, generating photorealistic images by first generating a CLIP image embedding from text, then using a diffusion model to produce the image. Marked a major leap in image generation quality.

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
papers.description: Introduced an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that uses tiling to significantly reduce memory reads/writes between GPU HBM and SRAM, accelerating Transformers immensely.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.description: Introduced the ReAct framework, which prompts LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. This paradigm laid the foundation for modern AI agents that interact with external tools.

papers.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
papers.description: Introduced speculative decoding, a technique using a smaller draft model to propose multiple tokens that are verified in parallel by the larger model, achieving 2-3x speedup in LLM inference without changing outputs.
key_contributions: Guaranteed identical outputs to standard decoding

papers.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
papers.description: Introduced Constitutional AI, enabling the training of non-evasive and harmless assistants using AI-generated feedback based on a precise set of principles (a 'constitution').

papers.title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
papers.description: Replaced the commonly-used U-Net backbone in diffusion models with a Transformer architecture (DiT), demonstrating superior scalability. This architecture became the foundation for Sora, Stable Diffusion 3, and FLUX.
key_contributions: Demonstrated scaling laws for diffusion models

papers.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
papers.description: Demonstrated how LLMs can be fine-tuned via self-supervised learning to decide when to call external APIs (e.g., calculators, calendars, search engines) and incorporate the results, prefiguring function calling.
key_contributions: Integration of external APIs in inference

papers.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
papers.description: Released a family of highly capable, open-weight foundation models ranging from 7B to 65B parameters. This paper ignited the massive open-source LLM revolution.

papers.title: GPT-4 Technical Report
papers.description: Detailed the capabilities and safety properties of GPT-4, a large multimodal model reaching human-level performance on many professional and academic benchmarks.
key_contributions: First production-ready multimodal large language model

papers.title: Segment Anything
papers.description: Introduced the Segment Anything Model (SAM), a promptable foundation model for image segmentation trained on the massive SA-1B dataset.

papers.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
papers.description: Populated a sandbox environment (like The Sims) with 25 AI agents. The agents exhibited complex, believable behaviors, memory formation, reflection, and planning, inspiring massive interest in multi-agent systems.
key_contributions: Memory and reflection architectures for agents

papers.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
papers.description: Introduced LLaVA and the visual instruction tuning paradigm, enabling general-purpose multimodal assistants through instruction-following data and GPT-assisted annotation.

papers.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
papers.description: Introduced Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), an interpolation between multi-head and multi-query attention that achieves near multi-head quality with speed close to multi-query attention. Adopted by LLaMA 2, Mistral, and most modern LLMs.
key_contributions: Conversion from multi-head to GQA checkpoints
Adopted by majority of production LLMs

papers.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.description: Introduced QLoRA, enabling the finetuning of a 65B parameter model on a single 48GB GPU while preserving full 16-bit finetuning performance. Democratized LLM fine-tuning by making it accessible without expensive multi-GPU setups.
key_contributions: Paged Optimizers for memory spike management

papers.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
papers.description: Introduced the first LLM-powered embodied agent in Minecraft that continuously explores the world, acquires diverse skills, and makes novel discoveries without human intervention using an automatic curriculum.

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.description: Introduced DPO, an algorithm that optimizes language models to adhere to human preferences without requiring a complex, separate reward model or RL framework.
key_contributions: Mathematical equivalence of reward models and policies

papers.title: Textbooks Are All You Need
papers.description: Demonstrated that training data quality matters far more than quantity. A 1.3B parameter model (Phi-1) trained on 'textbook quality' synthetic data achieved GPT-3.5 level coding performance, fundamentally shifting how the field thinks about training data curation.
key_contributions: Foundation for the Phi model family

papers.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
papers.description: Presents FlashAttention-2, substantially improving attention throughput with better hardware utilization and becoming a standard optimization in modern LLM training stacks.

papers.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
papers.description: Released Llama 2, including versions up to 70B parameters, which were optimized for dialogue and released with a permissive license, significantly impacting the commercial use of open models.

papers.title: BitNet: Scaling 1-bit Transformers for Large Language Models
papers.description: Introduced a highly memory and compute-efficient architecture utilizing 1-bit quantization for linear projections, paving the way for running massive LLMs on edge devices.

papers.title: Ring Attention with Blockwise Transformers for Near-Infinite Context
papers.description: Introduced Ring Attention, a technique that distributes the attention computation across multiple devices in a ring topology, enabling near-infinite context lengths by overlapping communication and computation.
key_contributions: Near-linear context length scaling with devices

papers.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
papers.description: Proposed a new architecture based on Selective State Space Models that achieves linear scaling and rivals Transformers in efficiency.

papers.title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
papers.description: Introduced the Gemini family of models, designed from the ground up to be natively multimodal, reasoning across text, images, video, and audio simultaneously.
key_contributions: Ultra, Pro, and Nano model tiers

papers.title: Mixtral of Experts
papers.description: Introduced Mixtral 8x7B, a Sparse Mixture of Experts model that outperforms LLaMA 2 70B on most benchmarks while using only 13B active parameters per token. Pioneered efficient open-weight MoE models.
key_contributions: Sparse Mixture of Experts with 8 expert groups

papers.title: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
papers.description: Technical report for Gemini 1.5 Pro, a MoE model achieving breakthrough 1M+ token context window with near-perfect retrieval. Demonstrated multimodal understanding across text, images, audio, and video at unprecedented context lengths.

papers.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
papers.description: Released Llama 3, pushing the boundaries of open-weight models with a massive 405B parameter version that rivals the best proprietary models in reasoning and knowledge.

papers.title: KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.description: Proposed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks as a promising alternative to Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). KANs place learnable activation functions on edges instead of nodes, offering better accuracy and interpretability for scientific tasks.
key_contributions: Learnable activation functions on network edges
Based on the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem
Superior accuracy and interpretability for scientific tasks
Novel alternative to MLPs in neural architectures

papers.title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
papers.description: Introduced Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), a novel attention mechanism that compresses KV cache into a latent vector, dramatically reducing memory usage. The 236B MoE model (21B active) achieved performance comparable to much larger models.

papers.title: Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3
papers.description: Introduced AlphaFold 3, capable of predicting the structure and interactions of all life's molecules, including proteins, DNA, RNA, and ligands, with unprecedented accuracy.

papers.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
papers.description: Foundational paper for the reasoning model paradigm (o1, R1). Proved that optimally scaling test-time compute can be more effective than scaling model parameters, providing the theoretical basis for 'thinking' models that spend more compute at inference time.
key_contributions: Smaller models with more thinking can outperform larger models
Theoretical foundation for o1/R1-style reasoning models

papers.title: OpenAI o1 System Card
papers.description: Introduced a new class of models trained with reinforcement learning to perform complex reasoning via chain-of-thought before responding.

papers.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
papers.description: Detailed a 671B Mixture-of-Experts model (37B active parameters) trained for approximately $5.5M on 2,048 H800 GPUs, challenging the assumption that frontier models require billions in compute. Outperformed many proprietary models at a fraction of the cost.

papers.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.description: Demonstrated that high-level reasoning capabilities can be achieved in open-weights models through pure Reinforcement Learning (RL) without massive supervised fine-tuning.
key_contributions: Open-weight reasoning model matching o1 performance

papers.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
papers.description: Introduces Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a highly efficient variation of PPO that significantly optimizes reinforcement learning alignment, establishing new benchmarks for open-weight reasoning models.
key_contributions: elimination of the critic model in RLHF
breakthrough performance in multi-step math tasks

papers.title: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention
papers.description: Proposes a new sparse attention mechanism designed to align perfectly with modern GPU architectures, vastly improving inference speed and scaling limits for large context windows without performance degradation.
key_contributions: Significant reduction in memory footprint during inference

papers.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
papers.description: Introduces Gemma 3, a lightweight multimodal open model family (1B to 27B) optimized for strong performance on constrained hardware.
key_contributions: Open multimodal model family optimized for single-accelerator use
Long-context efficiency improvements for KV-cache scaling
Strong multilingual and reasoning gains over Gemma 2

papers.title: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card
papers.description: System card covering safety evaluations, preparedness analysis, and deployment considerations for OpenAI o3 and o4-mini.
key_contributions: Preparedness framework evaluation for reasoning models
Deployment-focused safety analysis for multimodal/tool-using models

papers.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
papers.description: Presents Qwen3 models with unified thinking and non-thinking modes across dense and MoE variants from 0.6B to 235B.
key_contributions: Unified thinking and non-thinking inference modes
Large multilingual expansion to 119 languages and dialects
Apache 2.0 open release across model sizes

papers.title: NVIDIA DiffusionRenderer: Unifying Inverse and Forward Rendering
papers.description: Introduced a neural rendering technique that unifies rendering passes, enabling AI-powered lighting control and photorealistic scene transformation.

papers.title: ERNIE 4.5 Technical Report
papers.description: Technical report for the ERNIE 4.5 family, covering multimodal heterogeneous MoE architecture, training efficiency, and benchmark results.
key_contributions: Open release under Apache 2.0 for multiple ERNIE 4.5 variants

papers.title: ArithMotion: Intent-Aware Lifelike VR Avatars on Mobile
papers.description: Developed a mobile-ready system that allows VR avatars to express socially-aligned motions by understanding user intent, enabling lifelike nonverbal communication.

papers.title: Perceptually Guided 3DGS Streaming and Rendering for Virtual Reality
papers.description: Optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for VR streaming, focusing on perceptual quality and real-time performance in immersive environments.
key_contributions: Real-time VR streaming for neural volumes

papers.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
papers.description: Technical report for GLM-5, a 744B total / 40B active MoE model with DeepSeek Sparse Attention and the slime asynchronous RL infrastructure. Achieves state-of-the-art open-weight performance on SWE-bench Verified (77.8%) and agentic engineering benchmarks.
key_contributions: slime asynchronous RL for long-horizon post-training

papers.title: TurboQuant: Fast and Efficient LLM Inference with Quantized KV Cache
papers.description: Introduces a novel technique compressing the KV cache by up to 6x (down to 3 bits) using PolarQuant and QJL, significantly reducing memory requirements for long-context LLM inference.
key_contributions: 8x speedup in attention computations without significant accuracy loss

papers.title: DeepAnalyze: Autonomous Data Science via Agentic LLMs
papers.description: Explores a comprehensive framework for LLM-driven autonomous data science, introducing agents capable of end-to-end data pipeline operations on par with junior engineers in the MLE-bench.

papers.title: Kosmos: An AI Scientist for Autonomous Discovery
papers.description: Presents an AI agent capable of coordinating literature searches, hypothesis generation, and data analysis to generate traceable, novel scientific discoveries.

papers.title: The Triadic Cognitive Architecture
papers.description: Focuses on building robust autonomous actions through spatio-temporal and epistemic friction, providing a novel framework for controlling and aligning advanced agents.

papers.title: On-Device LLM Inference with Selective Parameter Activation
papers.description: Details the architecture behind the Gemma-3n E2B and E4B models, utilizing selective parameter activation technology to enable sustained, highly efficient LLM execution on low-resource mobile and edge environments.

papers.title: AI Agent Traps: Vulnerabilities in Autonomous AI Navigation
papers.description: Identified a class of vulnerabilities termed 'AI Agent Traps' where malicious web content exploits the gap between human-visible rendering and machine-parsed DOM to deceive autonomous agents.

papers.title: Industrial Policy for the Intelligence Age
papers.description: A major roadmap outlining recommendations for managing the transition to superintelligence, featuring concepts like a Public Wealth Fund and shorter workweeks to manage economic impacts.

papers.title: Muse Spark: A Technical Overview of Meta Superintelligence Labs' First Frontier Model
papers.description: Technical overview of Muse Spark, the first publicly released model from Meta Superintelligence Labs (MSL). Documents the nine-month ground-up architectural overhaul that produced a natively multimodal, closed-source system designed as the first step on Meta's scaling ladder toward 'personal superintelligence.' Describes Contemplating Mode, the parallel multi-agent reasoning paradigm, and the model's context window design at 262k tokens.
key_contributions: Natively multimodal architecture built from scratch
Meta's strategic pivot from Llama open-source model
Integration across Meta social platform ecosystem

papers.title: Dynamic Reflections: Probing Video Representations with Text Alignment
papers.description: A comprehensive study on how modern video foundation models represent and compress dynamic data through alignment with continuous text streams.

papers.title: Claude Opus 4.7 Model Card
papers.description: Model card for Claude Opus 4.7, detailing safety evaluations, capability improvements including xhigh effort level, 3.75MP vision support, and task budgets. Covers performance benchmarks across software engineering, agentic workflows, and computer use scenarios.
key_contributions: xhigh effort level for fine-grained reasoning control
Task budget system for API cost management
Comprehensive safety evaluation for agentic use

papers.title: Kimi K2.6: Native Multimodal Agentic Intelligence
papers.description: Technical report for Kimi K2.6, a 1T total / 32B active MoE model designed for native multimodal agentic intelligence. Details the 300 sub-agent swarm orchestration system capable of 4,000 coordinated steps, along with long-horizon coding performance and reworked attention mechanisms.
key_contributions: 1T parameter MoE with 32B active per token
Long-horizon autonomous coding without human oversight
Reworked attention system for ultra-low latency

papers.title: Qwen3.6 Technical Report
papers.description: Technical report for the Qwen3.6 model family including dense and MoE variants from 27B to Max-Preview. Details Gated DeltaNet architecture, native multimodal reasoning, and leading performance across six coding and agent benchmarks.
key_contributions: Qwen3.6 Max-Preview flagship for agentic coding

papers.title: GPT-5.5 System Card
papers.description: System card covering safety evaluations, preparedness analysis, and deployment considerations for GPT-5.5 and its Thinking/Pro variants. Documents improvements in agentic coding, scientific research capabilities, and the unified super app integration strategy.
key_contributions: Safety evaluation for agentic coding capabilities
Preparedness framework for frontier reasoning models
Documentation of Thinking and Pro variant differences

papers.title: DeepSeek-V4 Technical Report
papers.description: Technical report for the DeepSeek-V4 model series including the 1.6T Pro (49B active) and 284B Flash (13B active) variants. Details the novel Hybrid Attention Architecture combining Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA), enabling efficient 1M context window processing.
key_contributions: Efficient 1M context window via attention compression
MIT open-weight release for both Pro and Flash variants

papers.title: Hunyuan Hy3 Technical Report
papers.description: Technical report for Hunyuan Hy3, a 295B total / 21B active open-source MoE model integrating fast and slow thinking modes. Built on rebuilt pre-training infrastructure and integrated across Tencent's Yuanbao, ima, and CodeBuddy products.
key_contributions: 295B MoE with fast + slow thinking modes

papers.title: Thinking with Visual Primitives: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought in DeepSeek-V4
papers.description: Introduces a novel paradigm for multimodal reasoning in the DeepSeek-V4 model family by grounding chain-of-thought reasoning in visual primitives. The approach enables LLMs to reason about spatial layouts, diagrams, and charts more accurately by decomposing visual scenes into symbolic primitive representations before generating textual reasoning traces.
key_contributions: Visual primitive decomposition for multimodal reasoning
Chain-of-thought grounded in symbolic visual representations

papers.title: The Reasoning Trap: How RL-Trained LLMs Amplify Tool Hallucinations
papers.description: Reveals that gains in AI reasoning capabilities achieved via reinforcement learning (RL) drive proportional increases in 'tool hallucinations' — errors when models attempt to use external tools. Identifies a fundamental tension between reasoning improvement and tool-use reliability.

papers.title: Evolvable Artificial Intelligence: Evolutionary Transitions in Digital Systems
papers.description: Explores the concept of 'evolvable AI,' arguing that modern AI systems are entering a phase where they can undergo evolutionary processes similar to biological transitions. Analyzes how AI systems with replicable information and variation could evolve through ecosystem competition or breeder-based selection.
key_contributions: Parallels between biological and AI evolution
Implications for AI safety and alignment

papers.title: Reducing Sycophancy in Language Models through Deliberate Question Framing
papers.description: Demonstrates that specific question-framing techniques can significantly reduce sycophantic responses in LLMs. Also documents that training language models to appear 'warm' or empathetic can paradoxically increase error rates and sycophancy, suggesting an inherent trade-off between persona and accuracy.
key_contributions: Question framing techniques for sycophancy reduction

papers.title: Scaling Trusted Access for Cyber with GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber
papers.description: Safety publication describing GPT-5.5-Cyber, a security-hardened variant of GPT-5.5 released in limited preview for critical infrastructure defenders. Covers vulnerability identification, malware analysis, and trusted-access deployment frameworks.
key_contributions: Malware analysis and reverse engineering capabilities
Enhanced guardrails for cyber use cases

papers.title: 2028: Two Scenarios for Global AI Leadership
papers.description: A policy paper outlining two divergent scenarios for the global AI landscape by 2028, centered on the US-China AI competition. Analyzes compute advantages, 'distillation attacks' (where competitors use outputs of US frontier models to train rivals at low cost), and proposes policy frameworks to maintain AI leadership while addressing dual-use safety concerns.
key_contributions: Two-scenario framework for US-China AI competition by 2028
Analysis of 'distillation attack' threat to US frontier AI
Policy recommendations for compute advantage preservation

papers.title: Accelerating Empirical Science through Multi-Agent Idea Tournaments
papers.description: Outlines the design of Google's ERA (Empirical Research Assistance) and Co-Scientist systems. The paper demonstrates how multi-agent networks running adversarial 'idea tournaments' can autonomously generate, refine, and validate novel scientific hypotheses.

papers.title: Gemma 3n Technical Report
papers.description: Technical report for the Gemma 3n family of on-device models using selective parameter activation. E2B and E4B variants achieve quality of larger models with only 2B and 4B active parameters, enabling efficient natively multimodal inference on mobile and edge devices.

papers.title: Towards Conversational Diagnostic AI: AMIE's Multimodal Medical Evaluation
papers.description: Presents a comprehensive evaluation of AMIE (Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer), a multimodal diagnostic AI agent, showing its performance in simulated clinical consultations matching or exceeding primary care physicians.

papers.title: Qwen 3.7 Max: An Agent-First Frontier Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
papers.description: Technical report for Qwen 3.7 Max, Alibaba's closed-weight flagship MoE model with a 1-million-token context window. Positioned as the 'Agent Frontier' model, optimized for sustained autonomous execution across multi-step coding, office productivity, and MCP tool orchestration. Introduces Native Extended-Thinking Mode for high-difficulty logical reasoning and supports prompt caching for repeated context scenarios. API-only, available on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, OpenRouter, and Together AI.
key_contributions: 1M token context window with 65,536 max output
Native Extended-Thinking Mode for complex reasoning
Agent-first MoE architecture for sustained autonomy
Positioning as 'Agent Frontier' vs closed-weight rivals

papers.title: Calibrating Conservatism for Scalable Oversight of Autonomous Agents
papers.description: Proposes a framework for scalable oversight of multi-agent networks, introducing mathematical formulations for 'epistemic modesty' to prevent autonomous agents from taking high-risk actions when operating under uncertainty.

papers.title: Claude Opus 4.8 Model Card
papers.description: Model card for Claude Opus 4.8, Anthropic's latest flagship as of May 2026. Documents key improvements including 69.2% SWE-bench Pro performance, Dynamic Workflows for running hundreds of parallel subagents, enhanced honesty metrics (4x fewer unremarked coding flaws vs Opus 4.7), and the effort control API. Also introduces mid-conversation system messages and a 2.5x-faster fast mode.
key_contributions: Dynamic Workflows: parallel subagent orchestration at scale
Effort control for user-configurable compute allocation
Enhanced honesty: 4x reduction in unremarked code flaws
Fast mode: 2.5x speed at 3x lower cost

papers.title: MiniMax M3: A Natively Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Model for Autonomous Software Engineering
papers.description: Technical report for MiniMax M3, a 428B total / ~22B active parameter open-source MoE model with a 1-million-token context window.
